purpose: Define, mechanically, which expert-memory and overhead observables a future counted Research 3 run must carry, how each is obtained, and when a run or cell is inadmissible. This contract freezes observability only: it does not freeze the R3 policy, the R3 scientific endpoint, any DEV selection, or any EVAL decision rule.

scope.applies_to: every counted launch, and every comparison cell, of any Research 3 experiment that reasons about expert-memory cost or runtime value
scope.does_not_apply_to: Research 2 frozen evidence (read-only), the R2 paper, and any run that is explicitly diagnostic, warmup, or pre-canonical
scope.enforcement_point: run-record admission before analysis; no analysis may consume a record that this contract rejects

TRACE_COUNT.purpose: exact expert-level memory counters, derived from the retention-decision trace
TRACE_COUNT.rationale: enabling the decision trace slows the runtime by roughly 5x (measured: 0.83 vs 4.19 decode tokens/s on the same cell); counts are unaffected, wall-clock is not
TRACE_COUNT.artifact: retention-decision trace (JSONL: one decision row per (step, layer) plus one completion row per step)

TIMING.purpose: real wall-clock, per-process CPU, and policy bookkeeping counters; no expert-memory counters are claimed
TIMING.artifact: run record with wall-clock timestamps and the retention diagnostics line

fields.name: expert_bytes_read
fields.source: decision trace: sum over decision rows of len(miss_experts) * bytes_of_layer
invariants: equals expert_miss_bytes (only misses read from the store)

fields.name: expert_read_count
fields.note: the runtime counts slice reads internally (psx_cache_stats.letture) but never exports the raw count; expert-object granularity is exact, slice granularity is derived

fields.name: expert_miss_bytes
fields.source: decision trace: sum over decision rows of len(miss_experts) * bytes_of_layer

fields.name: per_read_issue_timestamp
fields.source: slice-level I/O trace (patch 0003 research trace); not present in the retention-decision trace and not produced by a trace-disabled run
fields.note: exact only if the slice-level trace is produced; that artifact is NOT required by this contract

fields.name: per_read_wait_seconds
fields.source: would be derived as waited_ts - issue_ts from the slice-level trace; unavailable without it

fields.name: queue_depth
fields.source: the runtime prints only an average queue depth at exit, in verbose mode; per-instant queue depth is not exported
fields.note: a per-instant queue depth can only be reconstructed from slice-level read intervals, which this contract does not require

fields.name: resident_bytes
fields.source: decision trace: cache_resident_bytes_after on every decision row; peak derived as max
invariants: 0 <= resident_bytes_peak <= budget_bytes at every recorded row

fields.name: evictions
fields.source: decision trace: sum of len(evicted) over decision rows

fields.name: requested_experts
fields.source: decision trace: requested_experts per row (router decision, independent of residency)

fields.name: hit_miss_experts
fields.source: decision trace: hit_experts / miss_experts per row

fields.name: policy_decision_wall_time
fields.source: the retention policy does not time its own victim selection; psx_retention_stats exposes counts (events_served, predictor_decisions) but no per-decision duration

fields.name: decode_step_wall_time
fields.source: exact aggregate decode duration / tokens generated; per-step granularity is not exported
fields.note: the mean is exact as a ratio of exact totals; it is not a per-step measurement

fields.name: compute_io_overlap
fields.source: no runtime counter isolates overlap; it can only be inferred under a stated model of the read barrier
fields.note: must never be promoted to EXACT_RUNTIME without a new, contract-versioned instrumentation

admissibility_rules.rule: all mandatory fields for the declared mode are present and non-null
telemetry.mode equals the mode the record is submitted under
telemetry.trace_sha256 is a 64-hex digest of the archived decision trace
telemetry.status is COMPLETE; a trace with a missing completion row or a budget violation is never COMPLETE
ttft, decode duration, tokens and process CPU time are strictly positive
the TRACE_COUNT and TIMING runs of a cell share workload, seed, budget, policy and policy-parameter digest
the TRACE_COUNT and TIMING runs produced identical output_token_digest, proving the tracing did not change decisions

cell_pairing.unit: one comparison cell = one TRACE_COUNT run + one TIMING run of the same physical configuration
cell_pairing.no_mixing: counters from one mode may never be combined with timing from a different instrumentation mode within the same comparison
cell_pairing.overhead: policy overhead is bounded by events_served and process CPU time; it is never claimed to be isolated unless a sham-policy control is run (not required by this contract, but required before any overhead-difference claim)

prohibited_uses: treating expert_bytes_read or expert_miss_bytes as throughput evidence
converting miss bytes into seconds with a model and reporting the result as measured runtime
using a diagnostic, warmup or pre-canonical record in analysis
claiming policy-overhead isolation without a sham-policy control
promoting a MODELED field (queue_depth, compute_io_overlap) to EXACT_RUNTIME
using any EVAL data to change this contract

root_cause_of_null_r2_telemetry.summary: R2-12 canonical records carry no expert-memory telemetry because the runtime never exported the counters it computes, the driver never parsed them, and the canonical runs neither enabled the decision trace nor archived stderr.
evidence: tools/r2_12_benchmark_driver.py sets expert_bytes_read, expert_read_count and expert_miss_bytes to None unconditionally; only coverage/band stderr regexes exist

the runtime computes exact counters in psx_cache_stats (hits, misses, evictions, bytes_read, bytes_resident, budget, blocchi, letture) and prints a human-readable line only in verbose mode, with bytes truncated to MiB and no raw read count
psx_retention_stats exposes decision counts and trace row counts, not byte or read counters
all 120 canonical runs have trace_enabled == false and no archived stderr, so no recovery path exists
